qolFindings.title: The completeness question counts only the rows read. It can be answered while unread lines are pending and is not asked again when they are left out
qolFindings.scenario: Paste 1 good row and 2 unread lines. The prompt reads 'Letti 1 allievo dalla risposta: sono tutti quelli del foglio?'. Tap 'Sono tutti', then 'Lascia fuori' on both lines, Controlla, save: 1 student is saved (probe final/ui U6). Each omission was an explicit tap, so this is not silent. But the count question was answered before the two lines were decided, and it no longer matches the saved count.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Show the pending lines in the question ('Letti 1 allievo, 2 righe non lette'), or enable 'Sono tutti' only once no unread line remains. Reset countConfirmed when a line is left out or a row is removed.

qolFindings.title: The header 'Eta’' with a typographic apostrophe is still refused as out of format
qolFindings.scenario: 'Cognome;Nome;Data di nascita;Eta’;Telefono' gives formatMissing and 0 rows (probe H). "Eta'" is accepted. Phone keyboards and chat apps often autocorrect ' to ’. The detail list then repeats the same reason ('manca la riga di intestazione') on every line.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Strip [’'] in headerKey. When a line differs from the expected header by one field, name that field.

qolFindings.title: An age/date conflict offers only 'Usa l’età dalla data', and a typed age is labelled 'Età sul foglio'
qolFindings.scenario: An assistant misreads the year (2011 for 2010) and copies the printed age 16 correctly. The screen shows 'Età sul foglio 16, dalla data 15', and the one button adopts 15 and keeps the wrong date. Controlla is still required and the date is visible, so this is not unreviewed. A typed age is also called 'sul foglio'.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Add 'Correggi la data', which focuses the date input. Label an age the operator typed 'Età inserita'.

qolFindings.title: V5R2-8 residual: an age written in the Telefono column is discarded without a hint when the phone is off
qolFindings.scenario: 'Veldor;Marta;;;16' with the phone off reads a row with no age. It then asks for an age, so nothing wrong is saved. The 16 that was on the line is not shown.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: When the phone is off and the Telefono field is not empty, keep the row but show 'valore nella colonna Telefono ignorato: 16'.

qolFindings.title: V5R2-9 residual: a same-origin GET that carries roster text would pass the no-network assertion
qolFindings.scenario: The spec refuses foreign hosts and any non-GET request. A regression that requested /x?n=Bianchi%3BSara from its own origin would still pass.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Also assert that no recorded request URL contains a pasted value (Bianchi, Sara, 2011).
